[ASSISTANT_SAID] Sustainability has become important, with green building practices like renewable energy sources, water conservation, and energy-efficient materials.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The construction industry has adapted to changing needs by incorporating modern technologies and sustainable practices for efficient and environmentally friendly buildings.  
[USER] User found the information interesting and asked for specific examples of changes in cities worldwide.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided examples of changes in the construction industry:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Burj Khalifa in Dubai, UAE, used BIM technology for optimization.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Bullitt Center in Seattle, USA, generates its own energy and uses rainwater harvesting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Pixel Building in Melbourne, Australia, is carbon-neutral and uses geothermal cooling and photovoltaic cells.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Masdar City project in Abu Dhabi, UAE, aims to be carbon-neutral and prioritizes alternative transportation.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Changes in the construction industry are likely to become more widespread and the norm.
